title: Community gallery
subtitle: Discover designs by others and show off your own. Every design is reviewed before it is published.
disabled: The gallery is not enabled in this installation.
loadError: That did not work. Please try again.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.text: Be the first to share a design! Create something in the editor and upload it.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: You need an account to upload and like. Browsing and reporting work without one.
login.linkSentHint: Open the link in this browser and you are signed in. Check your spam folder too.
login.ageHint: Accounts are for people aged 16 or older, or with a parent's permission.

share.title: Share design in the gallery
share.intro: Your design is uploaded together with the images it uses. Others can view it, like it and load it into their editor.
share.empty: Your design is still empty. Add some layers in the editor first.
share.rights: I own the rights to all images used. They are my own work or I am allowed to share them.
share.terms: I have read and agree to the {link}.
share.review: New designs are reviewed first and published afterwards. This can take a while. You can delete a design at any time.
share.needLogin: You need to be signed in to upload.
share.successText: Your design is now being reviewed. Once approved it will appear in the gallery. You can follow its status under “My uploads”.

report.title: Report design

reasons.personal_data: Personal data or photos of people

report.detailsPlaceholder: For example: The image comes from … and does not belong to the creator.
report.emailHint: Only used for questions about this report. Without it the report stays anonymous.
report.dsaNote: With this report you can notify us of illegal content under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act. We review every report.
report.orMail: You can also write to us:
report.noLogin: You do not need an account for this.
report.thanksText: We will look at the design. If it is reported several times it is hidden as a precaution.

detail.notFoundText: It was deleted, is still under review, or the link is wrong.
detail.notPublicHint: This design is not public. Only you and the moderation team can see it.
detail.replaceConfirm: Your current design in the editor will be replaced. Tip: save it under “My designs” first. Open anyway?
detail.disclaimer: Unofficial fan design. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

mine.title: My uploads
mine.needLogin: Sign in to see your uploads.
mine.nameHint: {min} to {max} characters. Please do not use your real name.

mine.hiddenHint: Currently hidden because it was reported.

mine.accountDelete: Want your account and all uploads deleted? Just send us an e-mail:

admin.noAccess: You do not have permission to see this.
admin.rejectConfirm: Reject “{title}”? Its files will be deleted.
admin.republishConfirm: Publish “{title}” again? Open reports about it will be dismissed.
